conf.description: Tanium action-history, LEEF: split header + KVP the attribute body into tanium_fields, map action columns to ECS, tag event.dataset. Command masking is a documented gap (no algorithm given).

conf.comment: Tanium action-history / syslog-leef: Connect emits a LEEF header followed by tab-delimited key=value attributes. Split the header with regex_extract, then serde-KVP into tanium_fields, map ActionId/ActionName/Command/Issuer/Status (named in the format's enable text) to event.id/event.action/process.command_line+args/user.name/event.outcome, set _time from StartTime (recommendation prose) with a fallback, tag event.dataset. Masking credential material out of Command is recommended but NOT implemented: the work order names no algorithm or token scheme, and the brief says not to invent one -- documented gap. StartTime/InsertTime/Expiration are timezone-less per the source notes; this pipeline parses them as-is (no deployment-specific TZ offset available), which is an approximation. _raw is kept per the recommendation to preserve the full line for audit forensics. Direct route, no guard hop.
